subtitle.zh: Local real-time portrait video: one portrait + one voice track -> lip-synced mp4 (SoulX-FlashHead 1.3B Model_Lite, 33-frame streaming, 512x512 @25fps).
subtitle.en: Local real-time portrait video: one portrait + one voice track -> lip-synced mp4 (SoulX-FlashHead 1.3B Model_Lite, 33-frame streaming, 512x512 @25fps).

notes.zh: MTNode runs the official SoulX-FlashHead inference repo behind its own stdlib HTTP service (127.0.0.1:8198); the soulxflashhead_gen canvas node takes a portrait + an audio track and returns an mp4 muxed with the original audio. Model_Lite streams 24 new frames per 33-frame window, so a long audio track is generated in one pass (no host-side chunking).
